data: NVIDIA's net income rose from $9,752 million in fiscal 2022 (year ended January 30, 2022) to $29,760 million in fiscal 2024 (year ended January 28, 2024), an increase of $20,008 million, or about 205%. In other words, net income roughly tripled over the two years. The path was uneven: fiscal 2023 net income dipped to $4,368 million, partly because of a $1,353 million acquisition termination cost, before the sharp rebound in fiscal 2024, when revenue grew to $60,922 million from $26,974 million.
